abstract: BACKGROUND: The purpose of this study is to share our experience with extensive sacrococcygeal teratoma, paying particular attention to neurological function, intraoperative hemorrhage, rate of tumor recurrence, and the surgical procedure. METHODS: Infants and children with sacrococcygeal teratoma were selected and generally examined in order to detect other associated anomalies. Patients with giant sacrococcygeal tumor and high output heart failure were managed by the abdominosacral route while patients with small sacrococcygeal tumor and normal cardiac function were managed by the sacral approach. All operated patients were observed and followed-up regularly for a period of 1-3 years after tumor excision. RESULTS: This study presents 22 patients with sacrococcygeal teratoma managed over a period of 40 months; 18 patients presented in the first 2 months of life and four children aged 2-4 years. Fifteen patients were treated by sacral excision and seven patients were corrected by abdomenosacral excision and temporary colostomy. Benign teratoma presented in 17 patients, one of whom died (6%), and five patients had malignant tumor, one of whom died (20%). The fecal and urinary state was good in all patients treated by the sacral route. Patients corrected by abdominosacral excision showed varied degrees of urinary incontinence and constipation. Survival in excised malignant tumor was good following chemotherapy; three patients received chemotherapy with a 70% survival rate. CONCLUSION: Benign sacrococcygeal teratoma has an excellent outcome after early surgery, but the incidences of malignancy increase if resection is delayed.
abstract_ja:
背景：本研究の目的は、広範な仙尾部奇形腫の経験を共有し、神経機能、術中出血、腫瘍の再発率、手術手技に特に注目することである。
方法：他の合併奇形の有無を確認するため全身検査を行い、乳児と小児の仙尾部奇形腫患者を選択した。巨大な仙尾部腫瘍と高拍出性心不全を有する患者は腹仙骨経路で、小さい腫瘍で心機能が正常な患者は仙骨経路で管理した。手術を受けた全患者は、腫瘍切除後1〜3年間、定期的に観察およびフォローアップを行った。
結果：40か月間に管理された仙尾部奇形腫22例を報告する。18例は生後2か月以内に受診し、4例は2〜4歳の小児であった。15例は仙骨経由の切除、7例は腹仙骨切除と一時的人工肛門造設を受けた。良性奇形腫は17例で、そのうち1例が死亡した(6%)。悪性腫瘍は5例で、そのうち1例が死亡した(20%)。仙骨経路で治療された全例で排便・排尿状態は良好であった。腹仙骨切除を受けた例では、程度の差はあるものの尿失禁と便秘が見られた。悪性腫瘍を切除した例は化学療法後に良好な生存率を示し、化学療法を受けた3例は70%の生存率であった。
結論：良性仙尾部奇形腫は早期手術で極めて良好な転帰をたどるが、切除が遅れると悪性化の頻度が上昇する。
